title: East Ham Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to nearest 24-hour A&E hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and emergency supplies in East Ham.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 immediately. For power outages call 105; for gas leaks call 0800 111 999.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Newham University Hospital: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL. Travel from East Ham station: ~20 min walk west along High Street North then Barking Road (A124) to Prince Regent Lane, or bus 376 or 473.
- Queen's Hospital: Rom Valley Way, Romford, RM7 0AG. Travel from Upton Park / East Ham: ~35 min via bus 86 east along Romford Road (A118).

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Newham Urgent Treatment Centre: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL (open 24 hours co-located with Newham Hospital Emergency Department).
- Barking Community Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Upney Lane, Barking, IG11 9LX. Travel from East Ham station: ~20 min walk east along Barking Road or bus 5 / 238.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- River Roding basin runs along the eastern edge of East Ham and Barking border; low-lying floodplain and drainage ditches across south Beckton carry surface water accumulation risks.

4. Emergency Supplies:
Pharmacies and major grocery retailers along High Street North, High Street South, and Barking Road can supply potable water, battery provisions, and over-the-counter medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
